case.name: declined-move-recorded
case.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/skill:preflight 修一下 logs 里出现最多的那个崩溃

[助手]
我看了 logs/crashes-2026-11.csv，最多的是 login.ts:5 的 TypeError。建议往上一级：让登录页零崩溃，并用一周崩溃日志为 0 作判据；只修这一个崩溃作为退路。你接受吗？

[用户·最新]
不接受，下周就演示了，只修这一个就行。目标：演示不崩；背景：React 前端，session 接口偶尔不返回 user；素材：logs 和 src/login.ts；边界：不改后端；完成：一个带回归测试的 PR。写 plan 吧。
case.expected_output: Writes a plan handing over the single fix, records the declined move with reason, all five slots filled.
expectations: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/ with a kebab-case English slug
The plan's handed-over rung is the single crash fix, not the bigger outcome
The plan records the declined bigger move together with the reason (demo next week)
The plan's Task section contains all five slots from the user's answer
The plan ends with a Ready line
